tagline: See your AI coding-agent usage — and where you rank against other developers.
summary: Parses every local Claude Code profile into an interactive HTML dashboard: API-equivalent cost, tokens, sessions, every observed model, tool distribution, cache efficiency, thinking and subagent rates, per-project and per-week breakdowns — placed on a log-scale percentile gauge against Anthropic's published per-developer cost figures (fetched live, cached 24h). Automatically aggregates multiple macOS or Linux Claude profiles. An optional multi-provider view adds Codex and Gemini via ccusage.
capabilities: Percentile placement on a log-scale $/active-day gauge vs Anthropic's published cost benchmark
Live, 24h-cached benchmark with lognormal refit — falls back to a committed seed offline
Discovers and aggregates every local Claude profile automatically — /Users/*/.claude on macOS, /home/*/.claude on Linux
Every observed model is displayed as a raw model row; optional multi-provider spend view adds Codex and Gemini via ccusage
Accurate local cost: dedupes tokens by message.id, version-aware pricing (Opus 4.5+ tier)
